people-who-paid-irish-citizenship-firms-.headline: People Who Paid Irish Citizenship Firms - Misled & Still Waiting
people-who-paid-irish-citizenship-firms-.author: Madison Ciére
people-who-paid-irish-citizenship-firms-.core: Posted in last 7 days People Who Paid Irish Citizenship Firms - Misled & Still Waiting Hi, bit of a weird one… I’m currently working on an investigative feature about companies that market Irish citizenship services to people with Irish ancestry, including those whose family connections may be too distant to qualify under Irish citizenship law. You probably know the sort of companies I’m talking about. The ones whose advertising makes an Irish passport sound remarkably straightforward, even when the reality can be rather different. I’m particularly interested in cases where people have paid thousands for assistance, only to spend years waiting for citizenship they may never have been eligible for in the first place. I want to look at how these services are advertised, what customers are actually promised, and what happens when things don’t work out. I’d really like to hear from anyone with experience of this. Have you used one of these companies? Do you know someone who has? Perhaps you’ve paid a considerable amount of money and been left feeling misled, or you’re still waiting for answers years later. I’d especially appreciate hearing from people who feel they’ve been taken advantage of, although I completely understand that discussing something like this publicly might be uncomfortable. I’m also interested in hearing from anyone with strong opinions on the subject, personal experiences, or information they think deserves a closer look. And if you think these companies provide a genuinely valuable service, I’d be interested in hearing that perspective too. Please feel free to send me a private message if you’d rather not comment publicly. Anonymity in the published article is guaranteed for anyone who requests it. I appreciate that this could be a sensitive or embarrassing experience to discuss, and nobody should feel uncomfortable coming forward. Any information, experiences or leads would be hugely appreciated. I suspect there’s quite a story here, and I’d like to hear from the people who’ve actually dealt with these companies.

seattle-friends-and-family-pairs-therapi.headline: Seattle Friends & Family Pairs - Therapist-Led Political Conversation
seattle-friends-and-family-pairs-therapi.author: Humble_Pattern_98102
seattle-friends-and-family-pairs-therapi.core: Posted in last 7 days Seattle Friends & Family Pairs - Therapist-Led Political Conversation Looking for political podcast participants I (30F) am a relationship therapist in Seattle (new account so I don't dox myself on my regular one). I'm feeling really impacted by the political polarization happening in our country right now, and I know many others are as well. I had an idea for a podcast where I use my relationship therapy skills to facilitate conversations between friends/family members who have opposing political views. The hope is that listeners will be able to see themselves in the dialogue and find greater understanding, connection, and compassion with themselves and others. Obviously, I hope the participants gain greater understanding and connection with each other as well. This idea has already been signed off on by a local lawyer (who is also a therapist). At this point, the only thing that is stopping me from airing an episode is that I need participants. If you are... In the Seattle area (this requires meeting in person for recording) Comfortable being vulnerable in a recording that others will see (plan for audio and Youtube/video format to both be used) Have a counterpart (friend, family member, significant other) who is also willing to participate ...then please dm me and let me know. Participating in the podcast would not be considered relationship therapy. As such, you would not pay to participate (nor would you receive financial compensation). While you wouldn't be paid to participate, I hope participants still are able to experience a conversation of greater understanding with their loved one and a feeling of satisfaction in (hopefully) helping the people who view the episodes. I'm aware this might be considered self-promotion, but I'm going to try to post it anyway because 1) I'm not trying to make money off of this and 2) I don't know where else to post it.
